'''La Alta''' is a dialect of Lojban.
=Differences not breaking past usage=
*'''ki'au''' is an interjection for commands
*cmavo with diphthongs "V'V" can be pronounced as "VV" if it's illegal in Standard Lojban except when the last V is '''o'''. E.g. '''tu'a''' => '''tua''', '''ku'i''' => '''kui'''. But '''a'o''' doesn't change since the last vowel is '''o'''.<noinclude>
=Differences not compatible with Lojban described in [[CLL]]=
*'''.a''' is a synonym for '''.abu'''
*'''.e''' is a synonym for '''.ebu'''
*'''.o''' is a synonym for '''.obu'''
*'''.u''' is a synonym for '''.ubu'''

Other ideas can be taken from Logbanu dialect of Lojban.
